applies_why: The judge text resolves a link collision over Isaiah 7:14 by allocating the challenger's and defender's answers, so K-C governs how that collision must be weighed.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' required deciding whether the Isaiah 7:14 collision must be resolved by comparing the two chains as wholes by footing or whether splitting it into challenger wording and defender prophetic application and calling it underdetermined is allowed.
why: The judge did not weigh the [DR3] chain against the [CR2]/[CR3] chain by footing; it split the Isaiah 7:14 dispute into a wording answer and a prophetic-application answer and declared underdetermination from that split.
